text:
anais: Heads-up — we started seeing a small but consistent perf regression in our marketplace images when using CUDA 12.3 + driver 535.x on P4/G5 classes this morning. Trace looks like extra memcpy stalls. :eyes:

mike: Ugh. Is this across all models or just long context workloads?

anais: Mostly long context (16k+) generation and some embedding runs with batching. Short seq perf seems fine.

kayla: Any crash logs / nvml traces? can you paste a short snippet?

anais: Paste from the canary run: ```E 2026-03-22T08:12:45Z cuBLAS: launch timeout (cudaErrorLaunchTimeout), memcpy stalled for 200ms, NVML GPU-Util spike to 98%```. It repros reliably on g5.12x with pinned driver 535.86.

jordan: @alex (Marketplace) we should probably pin the marketplace GPU image to a known-good driver until we get root cause. Rolling images out with a hotfix is safer than letting customers hit it.

alex (Marketplace): Agreed. What's the candidate pin? Is there a validated combo we can roll back to?

kais: (kia from SiliconCo here) We validated on our side with CUDA 12.2 + driver 525.89 and didn't see the behavior. We suspect a kernel NVLINK interaction introduced in 535.x that affects peer-to-peer memcpy under certain batch sizes.

mike: So two immediate actions: 1) pin marketplace images to driver 525.89 + CUDA 12.2 for affected SKUs, 2) open a partner hotfix ticket with SiliconCo to triage 535.x regression. I can do #1 if y'all agree.

anais: +1 for pinning. Also request we add a canary job that runs our long-context generation harness nightly on g5 and a100 images post-image deploy. That would catch regressions sooner.

ci-bot: [job:redwood/marketplace-canary-long-context] failed 4123457021 — test-case: "dialog-16k-batch-8" — latency +23% vs baseline. Link: https://ci.internal/reports/4123457021

kayla: Good signal from CI. mike — can you add the pin to the canary lane first, then to the GA images? Keep a rollback tag like `marketplace-gpu:2026-03-22-pin-525` so it's easy to revert.

mike: Will do. I'll open infra PR to change the image manifest and trigger a canary redeploy. Also tagging @kia so SiliconCo has the exact repro matrix: 
- SKUs: g5.12x, g5.48x, a100-80gb
- CUDA: 12.2/12.3
- Driver candidates: 525.89 (good), 535.86 (regressing)
- Workloads: gen-16k-batch-8, embed-batch-128

kia (SiliconCo): Thanks — we'll triage internally and send a kernel diff ASAP. If it's a memcopy path regression we'll try a micro-patch; if not possible quickly we'll advise you on a recommended pinned driver for the next 72h.

anais: Can we also coordinate a short joint comms note for customers in the marketplace who might see higher latency? Something to set expectations while we hotfix.

alex (Marketplace): I'll draft a short advisory: 'We are rolling a pinned GPU image for certain instances to mitigate a performance regression observed with newer drivers. No data loss, only elevated latency for long sequences on affected configs.' I'll share for approvals.

jordan: Ops: set rollout policy to canary ~5% traffic, monitor p95 latency and cost. If stable after 2 hours, promote. If degradation persists, rollback to previous tag.

mike: PR opened: infra/marketplace-image#842, setting pin to 525.89, canary target g5.12x. Deploy scheduled in 30m.

ci-bot: [deploy] marketplace-canary/g5.12x started 4123457500 — canary id c-2026-03-22-525pin

anais: Thanks everyone. We'll keep the thread updated when SiliconCo posts their kernel findings. If partner says it's safe to ship a micro-patch, we can test next-day hotfix.

kia (SiliconCo): Posted initial notes in partner ticket #SC-993. Hypothesis: NVLINK collectives path change in 535 introduces extra sync cost for segmented memcopies. Sharing repro kernel traces now.

kayla: Good. Once we have their kernel trace, eng-runtime will run a binary diff test to confirm. If confirmed, we plan a back-portable micro-patch or recommend pin until drivers upstream patch.

alex (Marketplace): Draft advisory posted: https://docs.internal/marketplace/advisories/525-pin-2026-03-22.md — please review.

jordan: I'll monitor telemetry dashboards and post p95 numbers here after canary completes. :thumbsup:

anais: Appreciate the quick triage. Keeping this as the coordination thread for partner hotfix + marketplace pinning.

mike: Update: canary passed initial smoke at 4123459000, p95 reduced to baseline. Promoting to 20% roll after 15m.

ci-bot: [job:redwood/marketplace-canary-long-context] passed 4123459800 — latency within 3% of baseline.

anais: Nice. Closing loop when GA images are repromoted. Thanks team. :rocket:
